title: Arlington Center for the Arts

services.name: Space Rental
services.desc: ACA has spaces available throughout our facility that community members can rent for a variety of uses! We charge an hourly fee for the use of our spaces and have a range of furniture pieces and audio/video tools available for use in these spaces. Whatever event or meeting you may have, we likely have a space to accommodate your needs! Arlington Center for the Arts rents our Shaira Ali Gallery + Performance Space for visual & performing arts related activities as well as community events.
